'''Sporting macrobinoculars''' were a model of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] designed and manufactured by [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] sports enthusiasts. Integrating a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] onto the device, the macrobinoculars could display race times, team stats, and other data important to whatever sport was being observed.
